## Purpose

Evaluate cumulative untreated outcomes in the no-covariate placebo study for the reliability-restricted and full samples. 
Produce replication-aggregated performance tables and diagnostic figures for core and noncore counties.

```{r}
# Load combined saved predictions and inspect a few county/replication rows.
fits <- readRDS("data/simulation/sim_fits.rds")
fits[i %in% 1:5, .(model, s, r, y, y0_hat, y0_post_1)]
```

ADD POISSON NOISE
```{r}
# Convert latent mean draws into predictive count draws by adding Poisson observation noise.
# This changes posterior columns in memory; it is needed for predictive coverage and scoring.
draw_cols <- grep("^y0_post_", names(fits), value = TRUE)
fits[, (draw_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(lam) rpois(.N, lam)),
     .SDcols = draw_cols]
fits[i %in% 1:5, .(model, s, r, n, y, y0_hat, y0_post_1)]
```

CUMULATE 
```{r}
# Accumulate outcomes, fitted means and posterior draws within each county/model/replication.
# Use the existing row order; this chunk does not sort event times.
draw_cols <- grep("^y0_post_", names(fits), value = TRUE)
# Create cumulative sums by i, ordered by event_time
# cumulative within unit
fits[, c("n", "y", "y0_hat", draw_cols) := lapply(.SD, cumsum)
     , by = .(dgp, nc, model, r, i)
     , .SDcols = c("n", "y", "y0_hat", draw_cols)]


fits[i %in% 10 & r == 2, .(dgp, r, i, start_year, model, s, n, y, y0_hat, y0_post_1)]
```

FILTER 
```{r}
# Build a shared county reliability flag using median pre-fit RMSE across model rows.
# Keep rows below the scenario/county-group 90th percentile of that pooled diagnostic.
fits[, rmse_pre_agg := median(rmse_pre)
     , by = .(dgp, r, i)]

fits[, keep := rmse_pre_agg < quantile(rmse_pre_agg, 0.9, na.rm = TRUE)
     , by = .(dgp, nc)]

with(fits, tapply(keep, list(dgp, nc, model), \(x) mean(x)))
```


AVG (restricted to 90% best pre-fit)
```{r}
# Average cumulative outcomes and draws across retained counties within each replication, then score and export.
# The correct RMSE is se_diff; formatting to three decimals happens after summ_score().
fits_avg <- copy(fits)
fits_avg <- fits_avg[keep == TRUE]

fits_avg <- fits_avg[, c(
  lapply(.SD, mean),
  list(
    pcor = cor(y, y0_hat, use = "complete.obs")
    , scor = cor(y, y0_hat, use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman")
  )
), by = .(nc, dgp, model, s, r), .SDcols = c("y", "y0_hat", draw_cols)]

fits_avg[, .(dgp, model, r, s, pcor, scor)]
#------------------------------------------
#score
#------------------------------------------
fits_avg |> score_avg()
setkey(fits_avg, nc, dgp, s, model)

fits_avg[, summ_score(.SD, sd = TRUE), by = .(nc, dgp, model, s)] |>
  gt() |>
  fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = 3) |>
  gtsave("results/tables/performance_table_avg.html")
```

AVG (full sample)

```{r}
), by = .(nc, dgp, model, s, r), .SDcols = c("y", "y0_hat", draw_cols)]

#------------------------------------------

setkey(fits_avg_full, nc, dgp, s, model)
fits_avg_full[, .(nc, dgp, model, s, r, sq_diff)]

              , .(dgp, model, s, r, sq_diff, abs_diff)]

fits_avg_full[, summ_score(.SD), by = .(nc, dgp, model, s)] |>

  fmt_number(columns = where(is.numeric), decimals = 3) |>
  gtsave("results/tables/performance_table_avg_full.html")
```


```{r}
# Define model colors, reshape replication scores, and build performance boxplots by scenario/horizon.
# The main plot helper selects absolute error, CRPS or interval score, rather than table-level RMSE.
model_colors <- c(
  "TWFE"    = "#1b9e77",
  "ETWFE"   = "#66c2a5",
  "RW"      = "#a6cee3",
  "RW-IID"  = "#1f78b4",
  "RW-ST"   = "#08306b",
  "GB-Ens"  = "#e69f00"
)

dt_for_plot <- \(dt) {
  psdt <- copy(dt)
  psdt <- dt[
    , .(dgp, model, nc, s, r, abs_diff, cvg, crps, intv)
  ] |>
    melt(
      # ID variables to keep as is
      id.vars = c("dgp", "r", "model", "nc", "s")
      # Measure variables to convert to long format
      , measure.vars = c("abs_diff", "cvg", "crps", "intv")
      # Name of the new column identifying the measure
      , variable.name = "measure"
      # Name of the new column containing values
      , value.name = "value"
    )

  psdt[, measure := factor(
    measure
    , levels = c("abs_diff", "cvg", "crps", "intv")
    , labels = c("Absolute Error", "95% CI Coverage", "CRPS", "Interval Score")
  )]

  psdt[, s := ordered(
    s
    , levels = 0:4
    , labels = paste0("Year ", 0:4)
  )]
  psdt
}

plot_performance <- \(dt
  , grp = "NonCore", measure_name =  "Absolute Error", year = c("Year 0", "Year 4")
  , log_scale = FALSE
) {
  psdt <- dt_for_plot(dt)
  plot_dt <- psdt[nc == grp & measure == measure_name & s %in% year]

  if (log_scale) {
    ylab <- paste0(measure_name, " (log scale)")
    lower <- quantile(log(plot_dt$value), 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)
    upper <- quantile(log(plot_dt$value), 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  } else {
    ylab <- measure_name
    lower <- 0
    upper <- quantile(plot_dt$value, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  # TWFE median per facet (s, dgp)
  ref_dt <- plot_dt[model == "TWFE",
    .(twfe_median = median(value, na.rm = TRUE)),
    by = .(s, dgp)
  ]

  pp <- plot_dt |>
    ggplot(aes(y = value, x = model, fill = model)) +
    geom_hline(
      data = ref_dt,
      aes(yintercept = twfe_median),
      linetype = "dashed",
      color = "grey55",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    # Boxplots
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, outliers = FALSE, alpha = 0.7) +
    #coord_cartesian(ylim = c(lower, upper)) +
    # Faceting by dgp
    facet_grid(s ~ dgp, scales = "free_y") +
    # Formatting
    xlab("model") +
    ylab(ylab) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = model_colors) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  if (log_scale) {
    pp <- pp + scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10")
  }
  pp
}
```

```{r}
# Define coverage summaries and plots using the binomial Monte Carlo SE sqrt(p*(1-p)/R).
# Display nominal 95% coverage and clipped normal-approximation Monte Carlo uncertainty bands.
dt_for_cvg <- \(dt) {
  cov_sum <- copy(dt)
  # pp should contain one row per replication with columns:
  # model, world, s (Year 0/Year 4), cvg (0/1)
  cov_sum <- cov_sum[, .(
    n = .N,
    p = mean(cvg)     # estimated coverage
  ), by = .(model, dgp, nc, s)]

  # Normal approx SE (fine at n=200); or use p*(1-p)/n
  cov_sum[, se := sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n)]
  cov_sum[, `:=`(lo = p - 1.96 * se, hi = p + 1.96 * se)]
  cov_sum[, `:=`(lo = pmax(0, lo), hi = pmin(1, hi))]
  cov_sum[, s := ordered(
    s
    , levels = 0:4
    , labels = paste0("Year ", 0:4)
  )]
  cov_sum
}


plot_cvg <- \(dt, grp) {
  cov_sum <- dt_for_cvg(dt)
  cp <- cov_sum[s %in% c("Year 0", "Year 4") & nc == grp] |>
    ggplot(aes(x = model, y = p, col = model)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = 2) +
    geom_point(size = 2) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), width = 0.15) +
    facet_grid(s ~ dgp) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(y = "Coverage (95% interval)", x = NULL) +
    scale_color_manual(values = model_colors) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      panel.spacing = unit(1, "lines"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  png(paste0("results/figures/performance_plot_", grp, "_cvg.png")
    , width = 480 * 5, height = 480 * 3, res = 300
  )
  cp
  dev.off()
  cp
}
```
